en.headline: Police hunt four suspects after Tai Po knife attack injures 41-year-old man
en.dek: The man was attacked by four men, two with knives, outside a shop on Pak Shing Street on Wednesday evening; the case has been passed to the anti-triad unit.
body: Police are searching for four men after a 41-year-old man was injured in a knife attack in Tai Po on Wednesday evening.

According to police, the man's wife reported around 5pm that she and her husband, surnamed Lee, were walking outside a shop on Pak Shing Street when four men got out of a private car. Two of them allegedly attacked Lee with knives about one foot long before the group returned to the car and fled.

Officers and paramedics found Lee with leg injuries but conscious. He was taken to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital. Initial investigations classified the case as wounding, and it has been handed to the Tai Po police district anti-triad unit.
Police said they are continuing to search for the four suspects. No arrests have been reported.

zh.headline: 大埔男子遭四男持刀襲擊 警方追查四名疑犯
zh.dek: 一名41歲男子周三傍晚在百盛街一商店外遭四名男子襲擊，其中兩人持約一吻長刀具，案件交由反黑組跟進。
body: 警方正追查四名男子，事緣一名41歲男子周三傍晚在大埔遭持刀襲擊受傷。
警方指，事主妻子約下午5時報案，指她與丈夫李姓男子在百盛街一商店外步行時，四名男子突然從私家車下車。其中兩人涉嫌持約一吻長刀具襲擊李姓男子，其後返回車上逃離。
警員及救護員到場發現李姓男子雙腿受傷，但仍清醒，被送往雅麗氏何妙齡那打素醫院。初步調查將案件列作傷人案，已交由大埔警區反黑組跟進。
警方表示正繼續追查四名疑犯，目前未有拘捕。
